key_insight: KQML-Liver combines quantum machine learning with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, reporting 82% accuracy and 100% recall for liver disease classification.
clinical_relevance: The approach could support more interpretable liver disease detection, but clinical usefulness remains unproven.
method: Parameterized quantum circuits represent input features.
evidence_signal: On the Indian Liver Patient Dataset, the authors report 82% accuracy and 100% recall, outperforming evaluated baselines under a protocol designed to prevent data leakage.
watch_item: The abstract reports no external validation or specificity, leaving generalizability and false-positive burden uncertain.
paper_title: KQML-Liver: Interpretable Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Liver Disease Classification
